sloka: अरुन्धत्या विशिष्टां तां रोहिण्याश्चापि दुर्मते ।सीतां धर्षयता मान्यां त्वया ह्यसदृशं कृतम् ।। ६.११४.२१ ।।
transliteration: arundhatyā viśiṣṭāṁ tāṁ rohiṇyāścāpi durmate ।sītāṁ dharṣayatā mānyāṁ tvayā hyasadṛśaṁ kṛtam ।। 6.114.21 ।।

translations.english: "You were advised by me not to have any hostile action with Rama. You had not listened to me. This is the result of that action."
